notes.title: Chaos Chain Dev Update 9/3/21
notes.content:
[b]Hey everyone![/b]

I'm back with another quick status update. I wanted to go over another QOL feature I created today.

In the past with my games, I have always had some non-important NPCs with generic greetings. These could be common people, guards, and even some enemies. Their messages could contain useful information or lore, but they were mainly just there to populate the game world and simulate an inhabited location such as a village or hideout.

The issue I had with the system was that their dialogue was not important, but still appeared as a regular message and even if they only had a few words to say, it would take a good moment to read and then you'd have to click again on them to make the message go away. Not a huge deal, but since it's not anything important, it could be annoying and feel repetitive.

So, I created a system that I call "SpeakUp". It's very simple and it's just an addition to a system I already had in place, but it makes the game flow better in my opinion.

[i]Speak Up[/i]
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6836576/973622e22d781d2b5a98256218c304fe5dc67f5f.png[/img]

In the above screenshot, I am just talking to a generic NPC Junkie who apparently doesn't like the look of my character. He doesn't have any vital information, but some of his randomized lines may prove to have lore, information, or hints about the game world just like in my previous projects.

Some of you will find this familiar if you've played my last game, Lawless Lands. In that game, whenever you got a reputation change, experience, traveled, or when the weather changed, a message would appear similarly to let you know what happened.

Now, when you're talking to an NPC who isn't plot-related, their message will appear on the screen for a moment and they'll show a chat bubble over their head to let you know they're speaking to you. A faint sound will also play.

Anyways, that's all for now. I hope to get more done next week - I have been sick this week so didn't have much energy to tackle anything too big.

I'll have more info soon!

Thank you for reading!

-[b]Corrosion[/b] ːCStudiosː

notes.title: Chaos Chain Dev Update: 9/2/21
notes.content:
[b]Hey everyone![/b]

I apologize for not posting earlier this week, I know some of you have been eagerly waiting to see more about the new upcoming game Chaos Chain, but I have been very sick and in bed most of the time until now. I am finally starting to feel better.

Anyways, today I only have one screenshot to show off a new QOL feature because I have only worked a half day today. Hoping to get more done tomorrow.

[i]Floating Labels[/i]
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6836576/fc5e674118fb5e4c1186ce97f7c49c69f0a157b8.png[/img]

This might seem like a minor feature, but in the past with my games, people have mentioned they don't always know or understand what they can interact with. I have always made it so that if you hover the mouse over something that can be used, hover text (labels) appear over top of it. Now, you will have the option to simply toggle them always on. It may get a bit cluttered on the screen in small areas from time to time, but I have the opacity lowered a bit from my other projects to allow better visibility and high-contrast text to be able to properly see the label itself.

I have added an option to the settings menu that allows you to permanently enable or disable floating labels - independently of the mouse. If you disable the feature, you will get labels when you hover over something with the mouse, but they will always be on if the setting is enabled. Some people tend to disable the mouse, but this change will still allow this feature to work.

Something else that is kind of visible in the screenshot is the red diamond over the door. This is just an indicator that I created (it pulses over time) to signify that an otherwise static environmental object (such as a door, trash can, etc) can be interacted with. Doors that can be opened to travel to another area have blue arrows inside of them as well.

That's all for now, thank you for reading. Hopefully, I can have more info and screenshots soon.

notes.title: Chaos Chain - Equipment Briefing
notes.content:
[b]Hey everyone![/b]

[u]For those of you who missed the last announcement discussing my next project[/u], [i]Chaos Chain[/i], you can find that here to get you up to date: 

https://steamcommunity.com/groups/CorrosiveStudios/announcements/detail/5246117291297561777

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6836576/37cf25db4ec95381cb2716184fc089383d55739f.jpg[/img]

[b]For those of you who already know of the new game, let's talk about equipment.[/b]

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6836576/64df151097805d3f020cf38222ae5ff5ab46baa3.png[/img]

[h1]Equipment[/h1] has always played a significant role in my past games. Having the right tools for the job at hand is extremely important in my opinion, so I try to put that into the game worlds.

For [i]Chaos Chain[/i], this will still apply, but the system has been expanded and improved from my other projects.

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6836576/e79ae69e93dd2b97e560bd4ca9c4d5fd258f6772.png[/img]

First, as you can hopefully see in the image above, weapons have a pretty significant stat-line. A lot is taken into account and much thought went into how the stats function and what ratings each weapon was given. It may look simplistic, but each specific stat has a lot of factors to think about such as handling, ease of use, accuracy, speed, range, capabilities of fire modes such as semi, burst, and auto. The engine is somewhat limited, but I have done my best so far (still a lot of room for improvement) to make weapons feel unique.

Second, I've done A LOT of work on improving the combat system. I can't really show it off here right now, but something I'd like to mention is an EXTREME focus on sound effects and quick-flow combat. Weapons have unique sound effects and animations so you can tell what you are using compared to your enemies. I have improved the default battle sound system to include a variety of sound effects for each event so it's not always the same exact boring sound. There are several sound effects for each event like for example an evasion/dodge has multiple sounds of its own and then there are special sounds for bullets missing or a melee weapon hitting someone. I personally think that sounds make or break a game - especially when you're hearing the same ones over... and over... and over.

So far, I have around 50 or so weapons which are mostly melee weapons and improvised weapons, but I have a handful of fictional (based on real) firearms across a variety of different archtypes including pistols, PDWs (personal defense weapons), SMGs (submachine guns), shotguns, assault rifles, battle rifles, carbines, sniper rifles, machine guns, rocket launchers, grenade launchers, special weapons, and even some exotic weaponry. Not all of these are ready yet, but that's the weapon archtype/class lineup I'm going for. Like in my first game, [i]Waste Walkers[/i], firearms will allow for different ammunition types such as full metal jacket, hollow point, armor piercing, buckshot, slugshot, and birdshot, and even more are planned to be added. Depending on your preference, the different ammunitions will provide different bonuses.

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6836576/dc388ee7d346efb58f2c76172103a2de5ecb95a9.png[/img]

Armor is the same way - they have a lot to take into account. One flaw of my previous games in my opinion is that armor resistances were very minor. A 5% here, maybe a lucky 15% there, etc. The idea was to stack up on resistances you favored with your combination of chosen gear. Most of the time, the numbers didn't add up enough to actually make any significant impact. That will NOT be the case here. The equipment slot system is more straight forward, but each slot has a specific purpose. Armor is armor. It should feel like it. In the above picture, you can see the current (subject to change) stats for the ballistic vest. The resistance percentages are high enough by themselves to actually protect you from different damage types, but they may be bolstered even more by accompanying gear in other slots such as the head slot for headgear or even the accessory slot.

Theoretically speaking, if your punk has 8 health remaining and an enemy thug stabs you with a shiv for 10 puncture damage (lucky roll) and you have a protection (armor) value of 2, a toughness of 4, and a 25% puncture resistance, you'll only take 3 damage. The detailed math: 10 damage - (2 protection - 4 toughness) * .75 = 3. That's pretty helpful. Taking a third of the dealt damage because of having decent armor instead of the full amount just kept you alive. A leather jacket (armor 1 with a puncture protection of 5%) would have left you dead in the street. The differences between armor types should no longer feel minimal.

That's all for now, I'll have more information soon!

Thanks for reading!

-[b]Eric "Corrosion" Plasencia

notes.title: What's Next from Corrosive Studios? "Chaos Chain"
notes.content:
[b]Hey everyone, Corrosion here.[/b]

So, several people have been asking me recently about what I've been working on lately.

I didn't want to give any info out too early, but I think now is a great time for me to tell you all a bit about my new project. 

Let me start by saying that it's very early in development, so nothing you see is finalized.

[h2]Chaos Chain[/h2]
[i]A dark cyberpunk roleplaying game by Corrosive Studios[/i]

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6836576/37cf25db4ec95381cb2716184fc089383d55739f.jpg[/img]

-This is a project that I have been working on for a few months and it's finally starting to actually take form. The game is heavily inspired by a variety of movies and games including The Matrix, Johnny Mnemonic, Shadowrun, The Terminator, Total Recall, Repo Men, Cyberpunk 2021 (RPG), and a whole lot more. Of course, I'm only trying to get inspiration for the genre, so Chaos Chain will have a lot of its own content and lore. I'm really passionate about bringing this all to life, so I hope some of you like it so far.

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6836576/ad37bef03793018501f2f1a2c1573b88391c1e1a.gif[/img]

[h2]Background:[/h2]
[i]"Half a century into the future, mankind's world is riven and in a state of great social, political, and economic strain... After the end of the horrific pandemic that haunted the early twenties, big pharma became stronger than ever seen before. Medical research thrived and allowed for a multitude of tech advancements, but healthcare prices skyrocketed, causing mass inflation and shifting the world's economy... As a result, cryptocurrencies grew in popularity and eventually gained enough momentum to replace other monetary systems across the globe... Greed, hatred, envy, and panic then fueled the fires of war time after time, leaving the world scarred and broken. The U.N. has fallen and the war on terror has failed. Civilization is slowly collapsing in on itself... Now, most people cannot afford their basic needs. Society is fragmented and has dissolved back into a rigid caste division. Crime is at an all-time high and poverty is the new norm. Each day that passes, exploitation of the Earth's resources continues and pollution intensifies, making life even more unbearable... Humanity is in the darkest place of its entire existence... A dark place where you exist."[/i]

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6836576/fecced5e2930fa5078cdd9757356c4f6e914ceb0.jpg[/img]

[u]It's still very early off, and it will be a bit before anything is playable, but it's getting there.[/u]

-For the game's mechanics, I have read through a lot of reviews and feedback that I've gained over the years. I tried to create a good mix of both complexity and simplicity to make the game straight forward, but also unique, also while being enjoyable. There is no durability, no overly complicated armor systems, damage is straight forward, weapons and classifications for them are easy to understand, and so on.

-I want to create a game with a HEAVY EMPHASIS ON ACTUAL ROLEPLAYING. In the past, I did this with Lawless Lands, but I want it to have even more depth. Branching dialogues, non-linear sequences, player-influenced-events based on choices and character builds, and many other ideas. I want the player's place in the game to have a direct tie in to what they do. For better or for worse. I also want to highlight that the game will not be combat focused. It will still feature combat though. [b]Basically, I just really want the game to be much more dynamic and personalized based on how the player interacts with the game world.[/b]

-Combat as it is right now, is quick, painful, and dirty. Even if you have a clear advantage, you're still likely to come out with some scratches on you. Of course, armor will help - and much more effectively than my previous games at that. Weapon capabilities are also more diversified and streamlined, making them more useful depending on the situation. I've already made changes (a lot) to the combat system to make it more enjoyable and dangerous. For you and the enemies. I've also decided to make custom animations for EVERY WEAPON so it may take longer, but I think it'll make it a lot better. 

-The game is not always meant to be perfectly "fair", but that counts for everyone. What I mean is, if you can do something, your enemy likely can to and vice versa, but sometimes you may find yourself in a serious bind and you'll need to play your cards carefully to get yourself out.

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6836576/9183f8dbd6c925d659fee4a7908686336dff2dbf.jpg[/img]

-I'm pretty much building it from the ground up from scratch, creating a lot of custom assets (and a friend is helping me with character design stuff) so it will take time, but it will also be much more original. For music (soundtracks), I have a really awesome selection that fits my vision perfectly. I'm really excited to see it all put together.

-For character creation/design, I can say that there is a TON OF DEPTH. Skills, attributes, traits, flaws (something new that I wanted to do), occupation, etc. Characters are not all-powerful. They have limits and drawbacks. Psychological trauma and defects as well as physical with varying effects. Backgrounds will give key bonuses in various areas of influence that can help or hinder you in situations depending on what you have available. There are also going to be more out of combat skills so the game has more variety.

There is a lot more I want to talk about and show off, but this is already turning into a novel, so I will wrap it up for now.

If you want to discuss the game, give ideas, or just have the link to the hub, you can find a link to the Chaos Chain Steam Community Hub here: https://steamcommunity.com/app/1536730

I'll have more information soon.

Thanks for reading!

[url=https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6836576/1a3994ccd145768199bf31edb79d01bdea1cb37d.png][img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6836576/551a162736ad2ccd578f3145ff1e02529870d419.png[/img][/url]

-[b]Eric "Corrosion" Plasencia

notes.title: Lawless Lands Unrest Expansion Now Available!
notes.content:
[b]Corrosive Supporters[/b],

Hey everyone!

I'm posting this here so that everybody who plays our games has a chance to see it in case they're interested.

The wait is over! Lawless Lands Unrest is now available! It's been a long time in development, but the expansion is finally finished!

You can find it here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1408290/Lawless_Lands_Unrest/

There were a bunch of patches released yesterday during testing, so it should be all set for everyone to enjoy, but as always, if you have any issues just let me know. The main game also received a patch for a typo that was found while testing the expansion.

[i]"The Devil's Harvest, 347... It began as only harrowing rumors from abroad, but a foul blight has come and infected most of the crops throughout the Sagerovian countryside. Following its arrival, a plague struck down nearly everyone in its path, leaving the survivors to clean up the mess of their fallen society... With the armies off, fighting in the war against Stothlheim, Sagerov is left scarcely defended and outlying settlements are helpless, and prime targets for callous invaders... An old and all-but-forgotten foe, hailing from the eastern steppes, the Horde has set its sights on the lonely farms and plague-weakened villages, leaving nothing but smoke, bodies, and ash, in their wake... Among those villages, Ravlova, resting in the Strastobol region, is a small and insignificant farming community, where people work from dawn till dusk, just to earn even a meager living. Two in particular are a husband and wife, Kolyask and Ridina, who're local farmers with a family, but they're also part of their village's militia. Charged with protecting their land and their neighbors, they are the last line of defense... This is their story..."[/i]


[list]
[*]New Storyline - Play as Kolyask or Ridina in their quest to protect their homeland and their family from vicious invaders in a large, several hour long campaign!
[*]New Side Quests - Over 30 new side stories and side objectives, all relevant to the evolving game world and storyline!
[*]New Characters - Two new main characters to choose from, various new side characters, and even a handful of new companions and a Sagerovian hound!
[*]New Skills - Learn some new skills and abilities to give you an edge against your foes!
[*]New Equipment - Many new items and equipment like firebombs, armor such as brigandine and lamellar, and weapons to try out! 
[*]New Schematics - Demonstrate your ingenuity by creating your own equipment with new schematics and recipes!
[*]New Artwork - New character sprite graphics, portraits, environmental art, and more!
[*]New Map - Explore the Strastobol Region, set in the borderlands of Sagerov!
[*]New Enemies - Fight against fierce new enemies and a new faction known as The Horde!
[/list]

Enjoy!

notes.title: LL Unrest Status Update 4/19/21
notes.content:
[b]Lawless Lands[/b],

So, it's been a bit since I posted any public announcements about Unrest.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32931945/d11c6a65bfb391362767afc93086e9dffc477ea9.png[/img]

I've been working on this expansion now - night and day - for months. It's turning out A LOT better, and A LOT larger in terms of content, than I originally anticipated. It's already at least a good several hours long... And I'm not even finished yet.

Recently, I have gone back through to polish and expand everything that was already in the expansion and I can pleasantly say it was worth it. Even though it was extra work on top of an already huge workload, I feel that it really brings more flavor, definition, and content to the game world. There are over 20 (full) side quests, a HUGE central story, and a lot of new areas to explore and things to check out. Equipment, enemies, features, you name it. The game world actually feels like it is changing as you make progress and accomplish different tasks. Almost everything you do in the expansion has a direct and indirect impact on the game world.

I'm estimating that I only need a few more weeks and it will be done. I'm absolutely thrilled to say that and I'm really happy with the quality and the quantity of content that it will feature. I've worked very hard to make it a worthy product and addition to the Lawless Lands world.

I've done a lot of new things for Unrest after looking at feedback from my past projects, the original game, and requests for the expansion itself. I can honestly say that what I have currently is much better because of my post-mortem reviews, community feedback, and having my testers help me out. I want to thank each and every one of you who has contributed over time, has supported me, and who has played the game. It means the world.

Anyways, I'll wrap this up here.

I'll have more info VERY soon!

Thank you for reading.

-[b]Eric "Corrosion" Plasencia[/b] ːCStudiosː

notes.title: 3/23/21 FREE CONTENT Update 2.0.0
notes.content:
[b]Lawless Lands[/b],

Hey everyone!

I wanted to make a quick update today with some new ideas that came to mind. [u]This update is free for everyone who owns the game.[/u] When the Unrest Expansion releases, these improvements will also be in there as well.

First, you can now kick enemies. And it will feel great! It is a stronger, slightly faster form of the punch skill, and it has a chance to cause both hindered and crippled. Most enemy humanoids will try to kick you occasionally too.

Second, shields have been granted an additional skill called "At the Ready" which is essentially the action of raising your shield and preparing to try to counter incoming attacks. The higher your armor value, the better this skill will protect you, and you have a significant but temporary boost to your counter attack chance. A 15% increase! It is activated as soon as you use it, so if you're fighting multiple enemies, you have the ENTIRE TURN to counter all their attacks if you get lucky. Beware, enemies with shields can use this too. Most of them, anyways.

Lastly, nearly all humanoid bosses have been given a few skills they were lacking. Skills like punch, the new kick skill, and a few others. This will ACTUALLY MAKE THEM SLIGHTLY EASIER since they won't always be using the heaviest and best skills anymore. It won't be much help, but you should notice a (very) slight decrease in difficulty when facing humanoid bosses. Just because they're bosses doesn't mean they're perfect fighters.

These changes should help diversify combat a bit more, add some more tactical depth, and increase the variety of playstyles you can choose from now. The shield skill offers more defensive gameplay opportunities, the kick skill now allows you to play as a martial-artist monk if you so choose, and the increase in the available skills for enemies and the player provides much more unique combat experiences.

Check out the complete change log below!

[b]Update 2.0.0 Change Log:[/b]

[i]Bug Fixes:[/i]
-Fixed a few Bosses not having some Skills (They actually will all be *slightly* easier now that they will use some weaker skills periodically)

[i]Changes & Additions:[/i]
-Added Kick Skill (It is a slightly stronger version of punch, can cause hindered and crippled, costs 2 AP, all characters get this for free by default, most humanoid enemies have been given this as well)
-Added At the Ready Skill (Shield Specific - +15% Counter Chance, +15% - Armor - 1 Turn, costs 3 AP, all shields are given this by default, all shield carrying enemies have been given this as well)
-Added new Animations for the new Skills
-Added new Status for the At the Ready Skill

NOTE: [u]You DON'T need to start a new game[/u].

Please let me know of any bugs or issues you may encounter. The update will be available shortly.

That's all for now, enjoy!

-[b][i]Corrosion[/i][/b] ːCStudiosː

notes.title: 3/8/21 CONTROLLER/GAMEPAD SUPPORT Update 1.9.6
notes.content:
[b]Lawless Lands[/b],

Hey everyone!

So, the long-awaited controller/gamepad support has now been implemented. It's not perfect, but it works and I've done some extensive testing with my new Xbox-360/Xbox-One controller. For those of you who have asked for this, your requests have been heard!

[b]IN ORDER TO TOGGLE BETWEEN KEYBOARD OR GAMEPAD, THERE IS A FILE IN THE GAME'S INSTALL DIRECTORY CALLED "gamepad.txt"! 

TYPING "1" INTO THE FILE WILL ENABLE THE GAMEPAD AND DISABLE THE ADVANCED KEYBOARD SUPPORT. 

TYPING "0" INTO THE FILE WILL ENABLE THE ADVANCED KEYBOARD SUPPORT AND DISABLE THE GAMEPAD.

BASED ON ENGINE LIMITATIONS, THIS IS THE ONLY WAY I HAVE FOUND TO DO THIS.

YOU MAY NEED TO RUN THE GAME AS ADMINISTRATOR FOR THIS TO WORK.[/b]

Here is a step-by-step guide:
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2418987998

[b]Update 1.9.6 Change Log:[/b]

Bug Fixes:
-None needed!

Changes & Additions:
-Renamed "Settings" to "System" in the Menu
-Added "gamepad.txt" File to the Install Directory with a Default Setting of "0" (the gamepad is disabled and the advanced keyboard is enabled / setting to "1" will reverse the effect)
-Enabled the "F1" Key for use with Remapping Gamepad Keys (Only those settings should be used - the other settings are mostly overwritten by the game such as the screen settings and sound stuff)
-Added a Default Control Scheme for Gamepads

[u]You should NOT need to start a new game.[/u]

If you have any issues or concerns, please let me know.

The update will be available publicly soon.

-[b]Corrosion[/b] ːCStudiosː

notes.title: 1/17/21 Lawless Lands Unrest Status Update
notes.content:
[b]Lawless Lands[/b],

Hey everyone!

So, it's been awhile since I have posted any updates on the expansion for Lawless Lands.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32931945/d11c6a65bfb391362767afc93086e9dffc477ea9.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32931945/47ce35abfff1b3bfcdf7d15093f4312e79fed989.png[/img][/url]

Originally, I wanted to have it completed by now, but I have honestly not had much time lately to work on it. I'm in my final term of school and about to graduate with highest honors on my bachelors in computer science with a specialization in software and game development. 

As you can probably guess, school is extremely time consuming right now. The good news is I only have a few more weeks left and then I graduate and can finally be done with all that.

Once that happens, I plan to focus my time and finish the expansion once and for all and then move onto my next project. I'm not releasing any details on that quite yet, but it's going to be in the Unreal Engine and I already have quite a bit of progress on it. I now have the skills, knowledge, confidence, and proficiency inside Unreal that I have been waiting for so that I can start really showing off my talents. 

If that project goes well, I can continue to do this, but if not, I'll be moving on and look to link up with a larger company. I just don't know if I can live off of being an indie developer anymore. It used to work, but with all that the world faces right now and the changes to the visibility on Steam, I can barely make anything anymore.

So, as for Unrest, I have been little-by-little making progress over the past few months and have the foundation and a good bit of solid gameplay so far. I'm going to be spending a bit of time this morning on my day off to get some more work done on it.

It won't take long to continue building onto it now that I have the backend stuff finished, but I'm honestly just planning on waiting until I finish school to completely focus on finishing it up because I just don't have the time or the energy right now. My sleep schedule is a mess, I have been sick on and off from not taking proper care of myself, and stress is causing further issues. notes.content:
[b]Lawless Lands[/b],

Hey everyone!

When you start a new character after completing the game at least once, from now on, a special item will be added to your vault WHEN YOU TALK TO HUSTAN IN THE PYRSHEN HOSPITAL FOR THE FIRST TIME which will grant 1 free rank up for the main character, 5 extra max vigor, and 10 extra max spirit. notes.title: Quick PSA: Recent Rapid Updates
notes.content:
[b]Corrosive Supporters[/b],

Hey everyone!

I just wanted to drop by real quick and mention this. Some of you may have noticed a few small updates to Waste Walkers, Disgraced, and Lawless Lands, last night. I was adding a quick menu option to the title screen which will let you check out my other games.

Due to the way Steam detects you being in a game or not, the browser which opened the link to my Steam page was being viewed as the game running, so I'm trying to find a work-around. This is a Steam thing and not directly caused by me because the game is spawning a child process and Steam sees that as part of the game itself. As you can imagine, it's quite annoying. All I wanted to do was link my other work.

I'm currently investigating alternative methods in Ruby to combat this. If you have any suggestions, feel free to post here.

What I've tried:
-Thread.new - Steam still thinks the game is running even if the game closes but the browser remains open
-Fiber.new - Steam still thinks the game is running even if the game closes but the browser remains open

Currently Trying:
Separate Batch File - My thinking is that if I have the game just launch a batch file that separately opens the website, independently of the game running, then Steam won't detect it as the game is still running

Thank you for reading.

-[b]Corrosion[/b] ːCStudiosː

notes.title: Would You Like to See Waste Walkers 2?
notes.content:
[b]Corrosive Supporters[/b],

So, it's been an idea I've had for a little while, it's been several years since the first Waste Walkers came out. Would you like to see Waste Walkers 2?

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6836576/0ab805fd5e951a3dd1f9a5511e4a38606e732378.png[/img]

Link to the first for discussion purposes:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/371100/Waste_Walkers/

Now, it's going to depend on a lot of things, but I could start heading in that direction in as little as a couple of months. I need feedback, though, and I want to hear what you have to say. This is really my first time mentioning a sequel to the game (or any game for that matter) so it's just a topic of discussion for now. Nothing is definite.

The original game had the largest following of any of my games and tens of thousands of players. In the first few years, it was wildly popular and exceeded my expectations by a long shot. It was however, my first game. That means it was when I had first started college, barely had any idea about game design or programming, and just had a vision and brought it to life. Now, I have all of the above. Features that never made it into the first game are now second nature to me. I could do it, and I would, but it has to be viable for me because I would love to work for free and on nothing but good intentions, but I obviously cannot do so.

The expansions for the first game were well received and gained me a lot of momentum and great income for a time. I was able to focus on new projects and develop my skills further. The story in Waste Walkers Deliverance was hailed as my best storyline for the game as a whole and in general, I think it was some of my best storytelling and work.

I already have some scattered plans for this, but now is your time to communicate with me and discuss this idea. What did you like or not like about the first game? What fell short? What was great? Would you be interested in a sequel? Tell me!

The only way I'd be able to do this is to start off with a Kickstarter. I'd have to have at least some form of financial support to do this to sustain myself and help keep the lights on while I work on it. If I don't create this, I'll likely be leaving the RPG Maker engine behind for good to go work on later and greater things. Primarily Unreal engine now that I have the skills and knowledge to support it.

Please let me know what you think. I would really value your opinion and your feedback.

Thank you.

-Eric "Corrosion" Plasencia

notes.title: 9/27/20 Lawless Lands Unrest Developer Status Update
notes.content:
[b]Lawless Lands[/b],

Hey everyone!

So, as some of you may know, I started work on an expansion for Lawless Lands called "Unrest".

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32931945/d11c6a65bfb391362767afc93086e9dffc477ea9.png[/img]

I got the entire foundation finished and even started on the story content and developing characters and even brainstorming locations. I had planned to take 2-3 months to finish this project.

I will still be working on it as I can, but I have unfortunately not had any time in the past 3 weeks to even work on it a little. The last time I made a status post about it was the last time I actually was able to devote any time to it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32931945/ccdd2060d60db73316448809606d7621ae445df9.png[/img] 

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32931945/55a900c548038298c6407ba29f6765d5241b3f7d.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32931945/0e3901935eb3e882211cc1ec78bfda9be76a89dc.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32931945/34f02d07648c7a1408da8b9293edaf275fa97354.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32931945/f162ea4596603efae467171aee481dd0628274ca.png[/img][/url] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32931945/9e8225fc03cb5a02914861bdbff449aa891da25a.png[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32931945/1cdb721b63e5db11c70f83cad0e79d0d6b148aee.png[/img]

The good news is that I will still make the expansion and it will happen ASAP, but the bad news is that it may take a bit longer than I had originally hoped. My current semester at my university has me EXTREMELY busy and I have been doing homework nonstop.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32931945/8a678c1a32695b95751495dbfda55a1d6aba3677.png[/img]

Instead of completing my work by Wednesday at the latest of each week, I find myself still working on it on Friday evenings and then I have little to no time for my own work or personal time with my family and friends.

I'm in the final stages of my schooling before I graduate with my Bachelor's Degree, with only a few remaining classes. I'm hoping I can devote some valuable time to developing the project this week and hopefully to continue that as I have in the past, but it all depends on the size of my workload from school.

I apologize as this is a bit of a painful post to write as I know some of you will be disappointed, but I ask that you have patience and understanding with me as it is just as disappointing to me. Just know that it will happen, I just cannot give an exact timeframe.

Thank you for reading.

-[b]Eric "Corrosion" Plasencia[/b] ːCStudiosː

It began as only harrowing rumors from abroad, but a foul blight has come and infected most of the crops throughout the Sagerovian countryside. Following its arrival, a plague struck down nearly everyone in its path, leaving the survivors to clean up the mess of their fallen society...

With the armies off, fighting in the war against Stothlheim, Sagerov is left scarcely defended and outlying settlements are helpless, and prime targets for callous invaders...

An old and all-but-forgotten foe, hailing from the eastern steppes, the Horde has set its sights on the lonely farms and plague-weakened villages, leaving nothing but smoke, bodies, and ash, in their trail...

Among those villages, Ravlova, resting in the Strastobol region, is a small and insignificant farming community, where people work from dawn till dusk, just to earn even a meager living. Two in particular are a husband and wife, Kolyask and Ridina, who're local farmers with a family, but they're also part of their village's militia. Charged with protecting their land and their neighbors, they are the last line of defense...

This is their story..."[/i]

[i]"The Devil's Harvest, 347...

With the armies off, fighting in the war against Stothlheim, Sagerov is left scarcely defended and outlying settlements are helpless, and prime targets for callous invaders...

An old and all-but-forgotten foe, hailing from the eastern steppes, the Horde has set its sights on the lonely farms and plague-weakened villages, leaving nothing but smoke, bodies, and ash, in their trail...

Among those villages, Ravlova, resting in the Strastobol region, is a small and insignificant farming community, where people work from dawn till dusk, just to earn even a meager living. Two in particular are a husband and wife, Kolyask and Ridina, who're local farmers with a family, but they're also part of their village's militia. Charged with protecting their land and their neighbors, they are the last line of defense...

notes.title: Lawless Lands: Unrest (Expansion Reveal)
notes.content:
[b]Lawless Lands[/b],

Due to (surprising) popular demand, I've started working on an expansion for Lawless Lands - "Unrest".

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32931945/7523244772122cf8366f11561d304d775672c2c4.png[/img]

Unrest will take place in the borderlands of Crossia and Sagerov in the new Strastobol region around the village of Ravlova and will feature new characters, a new storyline, and entirely new areas to explore. Our new main characters are Ridina and Kolyask.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32931945/55a900c548038298c6407ba29f6765d5241b3f7d.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32931945/0e3901935eb3e882211cc1ec78bfda9be76a89dc.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32931945/34f02d07648c7a1408da8b9293edaf275fa97354.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32931945/f162ea4596603efae467171aee481dd0628274ca.png[/img][/url]

The theme in Unrest will be Eastern European and have influence from Poland, Ukraine, Russia, Lithuania, Estonia, Romania, Bulgaria, Latvia, Moldova, Belarus, and several more. The base game had a very Western/Central European theme, so this should give a unique offset to the flavor. Experience the Sagerovian culture unlike ever before!

Some new enemies will also join the fray - "The Horde".

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32931945/8a678c1a32695b95751495dbfda55a1d6aba3677.png[/img]

Inspired by the Mongols, the Huns, the Tatars, and other nomadic warbands, the Horde is a force to be reckoned with.

The expansion is still VERY EARLY and will take me some time to be able to show off more and to actually have something finished, I'm planning around 3 months. Hopefully, that all works out.

I'll have more information on it asap.

Thanks for all of your support!

-[b]Corrosion[/b] ːCStudiosː

So, I decided to break the final update down into two large updates instead of one gigantic update. Originally, I wanted this content to go with the remaining work, but I found that some people are willing to go above and beyond and help me with bug testing, and that certainly helps me a lot. notes.title: 7/25/20 Development Status Update! (It's almost done! Woohoo!)
notes.content:
[b]Lawless Lands[/b],

Hey everyone!

So, I wanted to stop by and just give everyone some information about how things are going and ask my current players for their assistance, as well. The game is just about finished so I hope you're all as excited as I am. It's been over 2 years that I've been working on this and I can say that the game is better because I listened to all of your feedback from my past projects and everything that people have said about this one.

First, the information.

I wrapped up chapters 3 & 4 of the story today and I will begin working on chapter 5 soon and then the release of the game into full release should still be mid to late August as planned. I have been working tirelessly, so there is a TON of new content. I've added over 15 new main quest sections that should add a lot of gameplay, but even better - replayability and choice. Most of the new main quest sections are driven by your decisions and can be done in several ways, so that is something to look forward to.

Second, the request.

If you have played the game and have ANY issues including bugs, errors, crashes, glitches, or ANYTHING ELSE you can think of, please - please - please post them on the bug reporting forum. I have fixed every known issue so far including even a few more minor issues that I found while testing, but I cannot find every single problem all by myself. Help me make the game even better by letting me know what needs my attention. I can only fix an issue if I know about it.

I will keep everyone updated as time goes on.

Thank you for reading!

-[b]Eric "Corrosion" Plasencia[/b] ːCStudiosː

notes.title: 6/19/20 Update 1.5.1 (Last Major Update Before Full Release Update!)
notes.content:
[b]Lawless Lands[/b],

Hey everyone!

So, here we are. One final major update will be released after this one, and that will be when the game is fully released. It may take a bit longer, but that's to be expected. All that's left to do is to wrap up the main storyline. I still have quite a bit of work left for that, but it shouldn't be too bad. I can 100% focus ALL of my time to it without being distracted by extra other stuff such as extra locations, side quests, and so on. notes.title: 6/6/20 Development Status Update
notes.content:
[b]Lawless Lands[/b],

Hey everyone!

It's been a busy week for me and I've gotten a lot of work done for the next update. There isn't much left for me to do besides finish up a few features, add a bit more content, work on the main story, and a few more areas, so we'll be fully released in the next few months - right on schedule!

I mainly was stopping by to just let you all know that the next update will likely be out within the next 2 weeks and will pretty much completely finish up the side content and the world map in its entirety, so then I can focus 100% of my development time on the main story and bring a lot more interesting main plot content for everyone to enjoy!

As per the request of several community members, I'm doing a bit more work on roleplay opportunities and specifically adding extra options to many interactions. These actions are going to be less mainstream and allow players to make even more of a "lawless" or "black-souled" character. I already had a lot of opportunities for players to make choices that were not "good", but it definitely could use some more complex flair and content. I've already begun working on it, so soon you'll be able to cause all sorts of mischief. In fact, you just might even have exclusive access to some less-than-reputable organizations in the game to help you get ahead of the curve. ;-)

I completed the final village, Veilneir, and it will be part of the next update. I hopefully will be able to work on the final city, Kalbeck, next week, but I'm working on finalizing a lot of stuff and adding more roleplay content like I mentioned, so it may have to wait a little bit longer.

I also wanted to say thank you to everyone who has stuck by me through this project. It has been an absolutely amazing experience, and I cannot believe how much the game has grown and how well it has shaped up so far, if I do say so myself. I'm really hoping people are enjoying it because I have literally poured my soul and mind into this project, just like my previous games. I've put everything I've learned in my almost 6 years of doing this into this project.

I wouldn't be where I am today without all of the love, care, and support of my fantastic community and fans, so I humbly thank you with my fullest and deepest appreciation. You guys have been awesome!

I'll have more info on the update soon!

notes.title: 5/20/20 GIANT Update 1.4.9
notes.content:
[b]Lawless Lands[/b],

Hey everyone!

Here is the next major update for the game! I normally would wait a few more days to release the update to avoid corrupting everyone's saves, but I am doing it now since there were some fixes that needed to be put in place. 

We're rapidly approaching the finish line! Just a bit more work and the game will be completed! Check out the complete change log for this update below!

[h1]Finished World Map:[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32931945/1c6d1a0f1be9c13134b891364b20477a5eb8cdac.png[/img]
The world map image is finalized and the in game world map is completed. Some things will still be added to it, but the layout above is finished! Decorations have been added all around and so has more terrain detail.

[h1]Bounty Hunting:[/h1]
Hunt criminal or creature alike with the new bounty hunting system! Bounties are posted all over the place, so be on the lookout for wanted posters with contracts to take on. Each bounty is unique and provides a unique challenge in some way. They also change according to progress to provide a fair experience. There are 7 of them in the game at the moment.

[h1]Base Building:[/h1]
The player-managed base has been added to the game! You can now gain access to an estate of your very own to upgrade and expand as you see fit! Complete a bit of the main storyline and you'll be awarded for your efforts!

[h1]Companion Dialogue:[/h1]
Companion dialogues are something that I have always stayed away from, but due to popular demand on all three of my RPGs, I decided to add it in. Once you have your base, you can freely speak to each and every one of your companions in your group and find out more about them. Each companion offers several different and distinct conversations that can be about pretty much anything. Memories, experiences, past romances, future plans, hopes and dreams, flaws, current events, etc. The list goes on.

[h1]Stability and Efficiency Improvements:[/h1]
With this update, there are a few minor bug fixes, a rare crash fix, and a lot of optimization. I spent days optimizing and improving background systems to be more accurate and perform better, while also increasing their performance. This in turn improved the game's stability and performance across the board.

[h1]Manual Save Deletion System:[/h1]
The option has now been added into the game to delete saves from the load menu. While there, you will see a tooltip that tells you in order to delete an unwanted save, simply press F8 on your keyboard. You will no longer need to go to the game installation folder to delete old or unwanted saves!

notes.title: 5/16/20 Development Status Update - New Features
notes.content:
[b]Lawless Lands[/b],

Hey everyone!

So, I just wanted to stop by and give you all a quick update on what I worked on all week.

[b]Main Story[/b]

The main storyline got a lot of love over the past few days and many new additions to this were made. Some plot twists, new objective types, a lot more dialogue and lore, and new characters were added. There's still a lot of work left to do on the main plot, but it's definitely progressing.

[b]Base Building[/b]

The much awaited base-building mechanic is nearly completed. Upon finishing a bit of the main storyline, you'll be granted your own estate to manage and improve as you see fit. There are over 10 upgrades so far which all have different distinct purposes, and with this, you can really make a place for yourself in the game world. Both for roleplaying and actually gaining drastic benefits that alter the experience. Some examples are serfs that passively harvest resources, a garden which can grow alchemy ingredients over time, sentries to prevent encounters in your base, a smithy with a usable anvil, you can hire a blacksmith which can be taught new skills to improve their capabilities and other artisans and merchants, etc. The list is huge and there is a lot of variety for different functions.

[b]Companion Dialogues[/b]

With this addition, I decided to work on a feature that I've been asked about since my first game, Waste Walkers... Due to an overwhelming amount of popular demand, I finally added multiple deep and unique dialogues for companions. Now, you can REALLY get an idea of who each companion is. Players mentioned to me in the past that once you get a companion and talk to them a bit, that's it. They just become a mindless follower. Well, that's no longer the case. For the sake of simplicity and to avoid causing other issues with gameplay hiccups and whatnot, I added all the player companions to the player base once they unlock it. If the player has a specific companion, they'll appear in the base and you can go and converse with them about all kinds of things.

Right now, there are 11 human companions. Each one of them now has their intro where they tell you about themselves, but then you can ask to speak to them further and they'll chat with you with 4 different conversations so far. It could be about regrets, past experiences, lost loved ones, old romances, memories, future plans, dreams, and so on. The list is pretty huge and the companions are extremely varied so there's a lot of new lore involved. You should be able to learn a lot more about each individual follower than you could ever hope to before because all the new dialogues were written brand new today.

[b]Settlements[/b]

I added another village so now there is only one village left to make and one city left! We're really getting there! The world map is about 90% complete!

[b]Save System Improvement[/b]

One other thing I did was add a save delete feature from inside the actual game. A few people asked me about this in the past, but now it's finally here. The engine doesn't have this by default, but now when you're in the load menu to load up a previous save, you can delete the save by pressing F8, so you don't have to manually go to the game folder and delete them that way. It's a simple feature, but for player comfort and quality of life, it's been added.

[b]Optimization and Stability[/b]

I also spent about one full day (one actual full day, not just a work day) optimizing the living hell out of the game. I made things run much smoother, got rid of unnecessary stuff constantly running and checking in the background, improved efficiency of several systems, and all of this increased performance. I also fixed a rare crash that has been causing headaches for awhile and squashed a few pesky bugs!

[b]Final Thoughts[/b]

The game is almost finished and it's come a very long way since it was first released in EA. I look forward to hearing what people have to think and if they have any suggestions or input!

notes.title: 4/29/20 Update 1.4.8 (The Plot Unfolds)
notes.content:
[b]Lawless Lands[/b],

Hey everyone!

As I said the other day, I've been absolutely nose-to-the-grindstone for weeks to get this update out and especially today. I'm moving in two days, so I won't be around much until next week, but I'll fix any issues that may be present ASAP.

This update greatly expands the main storyline with several non-linear sections, tons of new additional side quests that are unlocked by progressing the main storyline, new activities including monster lairs and outlaw hideouts that can dealt with for rewards, captives that you can find and free or you can execute them, several new locations to discover and explore on the world map, balance changes and optimization for the magic system, improvements to healing and magic potions, bug fixes, a lot more lore (in terms of items to find as well as rumors), new randomized world map events, new soundtracks, and so much more!

Check out the complete change log below!

-Made the Player Sprite Transparent for Intro again

Please let me know of any bugs or issues you may encounter. The update will be available shortly.

That's all for now, enjoy!

notes.title: 4/24/20 Development Status Update
notes.content:
[b]Lawless Lands[/b],

Hey everyone!

I hope you're all doing well and staying safe.

I wanted to stop by real quick and give you all a quick status update and ETA on the next big patch.

This quarantine has been pretty intense, but it has helped me stay focused on the game's development and I have a REALLY HUGE update almost ready. It greatly expands on the main storyline, side quests, new areas to explore, monster lairs and outlaw hideouts as one of the new activities, changes and balance to the magic system in the game, and a whole lot more!

The game world is nearing completion and then after that I don't have much left to finish besides the main story so keep in mind it will be leaving EA VERY SOON!

[u]I am planning to have the new big update out by the end of next week[/u], but that may be delayed a bit as I am moving next weekend into a bigger and nicer apartment. It wasn't all necessarily by choice, I've been dealing with dangerously shady and obnoxious neighbors for over a year and a half and I finally can't take it anymore. Reasoning with them is impossible and they won't stop. Nobody will help me with this including authorities as they can only do so much or the apartment complex that I'm at, so I finally decided to pull the trigger and save myself for sanity's sake as well as my family's safety. Hopefully, if everything works out, I'll have the update live by Thursday night. If not, it won't be long afterwards.

Moving into the new place, I fully believe my work schedule will be much better given that I'll be able to focus and not be distracted, bothered, and so on. I don't think I've had a full night's rest in over a year (that's not even an exaggeration sadly) and it will do wonders for me. I can't wait.

Rest assured the changelog is absolutely gigantic and has added tons of new activities, non-linear story content, and so much more. I'll post a preview of the new changelog at sometime in the next few days.

I will have more information soon!

-[b]Corrosion[/b] ːCStudiosː

notes.content:
[b]Lawless Lands[/b],

Hey everyone! Here is the next huge update to the game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32931945/06b2d2af23d0d81831e60991c7706fb5db14723e.png[/img]

This update adds a lot of new content and features such as the randomized rumor system, world modifiers to ensure each playthrough is unique, mobile repair system that lets you maintain your own gear, scrolls for spells, more skills, and a ton more! Within a few more months, the game is planned to be finalized and released!

Check out the complete change log below!

[b]Update 1.4.7 Change Log:[/b]

Bug Fixes:
-Fixed Paralytic Poison Recipe creating the wrong Item
-Fixed Snowbound Cottage Map Transfer
-Fixed a Bug which still allowed Companions without Spellcraft to gain Spell-Casting Capabilities

Changes & Additions:
-Added new Steam Achievements

-*Added World Modifier System to make each Playthrough unique (They alter certain aspects of the game world with both negative and positive effects)
-*Added 13 different Randomly chosen World Modifiers (According to difficulty level chosen - Easy: 2, Normal: 3, Hard: 4)
-Added "Shard of Darkness" Side Quest

-Added Faultless Passive Skill
-Added Unhindered Passive Skill
-Added Bloodletter Passive Skill
-Added Blessed Passive Skill
-Added Fortitude Passive Skill
-Added Immune Passive Skill
-Added Purified Passive Skill

-Updated Torch Crafting Recipe

-Added deeper Dialogue Options to all Civilians (Time, local prices, rumors)
-Added 81 Randomized Rumors for the deeper Dialogues (Some general, many specific)
-Updated nearly all Shops
-Added Scrap Item
-You will now gain 5% of the Durability in Scrap when a Weapon or piece of Armor breaks
-Added Repair Hammer (Has a 1% chance to break everytime you repair equipment)
-Added 3 Experience gained whenever Repairing an Item
-Added Ability to Repair Equipment without the need for a Blacksmith by using a Repair Hammer
-Update Loot Tables
-Artisan Background now starts off with 5 Scrap and a Repair Hammer
-Added Sound Effects to Play when a Weapon or Armor is Broken

-Added a new unique Encounter (Choice and consequence)
-Added new Enemy Encounters
-Added a new Boss (Crash - Bandit Faction)
-Added a new unique Weapon (Gained from defeating Crash)
-Enemies now Reward 1 bonus Experience per their Level
-Experience Requirements and Experience Curves have been adjusted
-Poisons no longer return the Empty Vial after use like Potions do
-Added a Sound Effect when Text Displays
-Added a Randomized Interior Sound Effect List
-Slightly Increased the Duration between Random Sound Effects
-Greatly reduced the Chance of becoming Diseased when in a Plague Zone (Instead of 15 out of 1000, the chance is now 3 out of 1000 or a .003% chance)
-Increased time between being affected by Temperature Zones and Plague Zones (Half a second more)
-Added a proper Description to Life Force Spell
-Added Scroll variant for all Spells (They are usable only once and then are consumed, they allow anyone to cast the associated spell, they are VERY slow to use so your initiative is much slower, they do not require spirit, they have a -5% chance per spell level to work starting at 80% and going down)
-Added Scrolls to the Loot Pool for Urns and Chests (It is a very low chance to find them, but even lower to find more than one at a time)
-Changed some Skill Use Descriptions
-Updated some Combat Result Terminology
-Made ALL Spells require a Success Check in order to work (This also means that even if you're casting a spell on an ally, it may fail)
-Updated many Enemy AI Skills to require a Success Check in order to work (Such as Set Bone for Skeletal enemies - it will no longer ALWAYS heal them)
-Restored Messages instantly Displaying, but added a subtle Sound to play whenever a new Message appears (The original idea was to indicate a new message was displayed, but it made the game feel very slow and message display dragged out - I think this is a good middleground)
-Specific Heavy Attacks now do +1 Damage but are -1 Initiative and cost 2 Durability
-Removed some Learnable Spells from Ashmand and Almaric (Priest and Paladin Companions - They cannot get black/death spells, red/aggression spells, or blue/protection spells anymore)

notes.title: 2/27/20 MASSIVE Update 1.4.5 [Combat Overhaul Pt2, Improvements, New Content]
notes.content:
[b]Lawless Lands[/b],

Hey everyone!

So, here's the next GIGANTIC update! There are so many improvements, so much new content, and part two of the combat overhaul! Here are the highlights for tonight's update!

[h1]Dungeon Exploring[/h1]
The dungeon exploring in Lawless Lands has always felt like it was missing a little something to me. Now, you'll need to actually explore dungeons and wilderness areas before they become fully visible. You have a visibility range which will illuminate the surrounding area.

[h1]Combat Facelift/Overhaul Part 2[/h1]
I went through all 285+ maps and individually gave each and every one of them a new and improved high res battle background. Besides that, action points and combat abilities become strained as you (or your foes) take damage. The status effects have been streamlined, battle status animations have been added so for example if you're bleeding, you'll see your character bleed, and much more! More sound effects were added, the "Broken" state was added which makes characters rout in combat when their spirit reaches 0, shifting morale which makes combat more realistic, and combat AI has been improved! You can also now see the enemy spirit (morale) bars!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32931945/e69a4fd36a58db1a20e75607c201d58ec2322541.png[/img]

[h1]New Game + Mode[/h1]
Tired of doing the intro? Worry no more! The next time you do it will be your last! You can always opt back in to playing it just after character creation!

[h1]Better Player Awareness Improvements[/h1]
The character screen has been updated to display more handy information that may have been a bit hard to understand or find and the main menu has been given a tips screen so you get a small guide (especially with states and status effects) on some gameplay features.

[h1]Cinematic Improvements[/h1]
There are certain times in the game where tension is supposed to be higher and more than just visual cues are needed. Music, sound effects, and other general improvements have been added throughout the game for these cases! More soundtracks have been added to the game as well!

[h1]More Roleplay Features[/h1]
Basic haggling has been added, improvements and fine tweaks with the shifting alignment system, more choices and consequences have been added, and more!

[h1]More of the Main Story[/h1]
Though it isn't much, the next few segments of the main storyline have been added. I got it to a good stopping point for now, so the next update will greatly expand upon it.

[h1]More Side Quests[/h1]
Multiple new side quests have been added to the game!

[h1]New Enemies and Factions[/h1]
The mercenary faction has been added, several factions have been tweaked and improved, and the bear has been added to the wild animal faction.

[h1]Many New Areas to Explore[/h1]
New settlements, dungeons/wild areas to explore, quest locations, and more!

Check out the complete change log below!

[b]Update 1.4.5 Change Log:[/b]

Bug Fixes:
-Fixed Warhounds not Automatically Unlocking Howl
-Fixed losing Spirit Points in Combat Incorrectly being Displayed (Example: "BLANK lost spirit points 5" instead of "BLANK lost 5 spirit points")
-Fixed a Bug that caused Buying Prices of Items to become 0 or even negative when Discounts are higher

Changes & Additions:
-Added some new Steam Achievements
-Added Steam Avatar for Kelis
-Added Steam Avatar for Fyria
-Added Fyria Companion (She is the second female companion in the game)
-Added Trait: Vengeance (Fyria)
-Added "Manhunt" Side Quest with multiple outcomes and beginnings
-Added "Forgotten Foes P3" Main Quest segment
-Added "A Friend in Need" Main Quest segment
-Added "Dire Warning" Main Quest segment
-Added "Final Wishes" Side Quest (Optional, given as part of the main quest)
-Added "Hollow Cries" Side Quest
-Renamed "Biography" to "Background" in the Character Menu
-Added Parallax Backgrounds to all Maps (To make the empty black spaces not so dead - this will be especially noticable in interior areas)
-Prowess is now deducted as a Percentage to Item Prices when Buying (This means you get your Prowess as a % discount)
-Prowess is now added as a Percentage to Item Prices when Selling (Due to this change and given the unlimited discount potential, default selling prices have gone back to 50% instead of 65%)
-Posture is now added to Action Point Maximum
-Added Delrye to the Signpost in Kordon Province
-Slightly increased the Chance of Armor being Damaged when Hit
-Increased the Distance moved in Combat
-Removed the -1 Disposition from Supply Stashes (Didn't realize I left that in there from testing)
-Added several new (optional) Battle Backgrounds
-Added 16 new Soundtracks with 2 Variants each
-Added Regional Backgrounds for the World Map
-Updated Random Encounter Regions on the World Map
-Added Hand Wraps Equipment

-Removed Alignment Shift from Investigating the Bodies in the Random World Map Event
-Improved the look of the Enemy Health Gauges (Vigor)
-Added Enemy Morale/Mana Gauges (Spirit) in Combat
-New Morale Combat System (Basically, whenever someone is hit in combat, they'll lose 30% of that vigor damage as spirit also, but when they hit someone else, they gain 1 to simulate the shifting tide of a battle, this number is kept low and at a constant 1 so it doesn't make things ridiculous for spell users, status effects still also influence this in larger ways so that it's not a constant back and forth struggle)
-Added "Broken" State (When a character is in combat and has their spirit reach 0, they'll automatically Break in combat and will not fight, the only way to remove this is to gain spirit or win)
-Updated Critical Hit Text to "Critical!" instead of "Critical hit!"
-Added some new Cinematic Style stuff to the intro

-Updated the Tutorial to explain Action Points

-Set the Music Track for the Intro Fight to be consistent with the mood (No more random music tracks for that fight)

NOTE: [u]You MUST start a new game if you encounter any issues, especially with quests[/u].

Please let me know of any bugs or issues you may encounter. The update will be available shortly.

That's all for now, enjoy!

notes.title: 2/3/20 Update 1.4.4 (Plagued Lands Update)
notes.content:
[b]Lawless Lands[/b],

Hey everyone!

Sorry for the delay on this one, I had a lot going on last week so I didn't have a chance to finish up the work for this update until today. I did add some extra goodies though to make up for it. :-)

This update is one that I'm calling the "Plagued Lands" update. It features a lot of new features and tweaks that make the Plague much more "alive" in the game world and much more of a threat!

Check out the complete change log below!

[b]Update 1.4.4 Change Log:[/b]

Bug Fixes:
-Fixed a Bug with the Lost Shipment Area for the Quest of the same name
-Fixed a Bug that could make Background Music Refresh multiple times within a 3 Second span upon requesting switch
-Fixed a Bug causing the "Never Enough quest to not finish properly
-Fixed an Exploit that caused the Blood Gate in the Old Catacombs to become permanently closed
-Fixed Warhound Skills being free
-Fixed an Interpreter incorrectly receiving the Variables for the Fog of War System (and sometimes it would get progressively darker)

Changes & Additions:
-Added some new Steam Achievements
-Added "Grain Disdain" Side Quest
-Added "Visions" Multiple Outcome Side Quest
-Added "Tears of Heaven" Side Quest

-Added 5 Female Pain Sound Effects for Combat
-Changed when the Extra Random Damage is added to an Attack so Blocked Attacks can no longer Result in Status Effects with 0 Damage
-Removed Self Damage from Cauterize but increased Action Point Cost (from 1 to 5)
-Changed Pyrshen City Center Soundtrack to be more Melancholy
-Lowered the Pitch of most Soundtracks in the Game to be more Melancholy
-Crafting now gives 3 Experience to the Player Character
-Changed Crafting Sound Effects to match Item Type being Crafted
-Added Mead Consumable Item (Alternative version of Ale, slightly changed stats)
-Added Fortified Boots (Unique Gear Item)

-Updated the Road Texture
-Updated Dirt Texture

-Changed the Intro section where you talk to the Guard Captain so it's automatic (He should hail you before you can reach the gate instead of it just saying you must speak to him first - breaking immersion)
-Added the Capability for NPC Companions with Independence Skill to properly use other Skills in Combat (Beta, please let me know of any issues)
-Increased Cost of Independence from 1 to 3 (As they will be much more useful now)
-Made Patch Up Skill Automatically Unlock at Rank 5, Energy Rush at Rank 10, Intimidate at Rank 15, Feign Death at Rank 20, Close Distance at Rank 25, Inspire at Rank 30
-Intimidate now Removes 20% Spirit instead of 10% and has double the Chance to causing Panic
-Player Character is now Immune to being Diseased in the Intro Combat
-Energy Rush now Costs Spirit instead of Action Points (Didn't make sense how it was as it would deduct AP and then grant AP)
-Updated Icon Art for Spider Stinger/Spider Venom
-Added Snipe Specific Skill (Ranged)
-Added Clobber Technique Skill (Bludgeons)
-Added Sweep Technique Skill (Swords)
-Added Disembowel Technique Skill (Axes)

-Added Delrye: Storehouse Area
-Added Corpse Pit Discoverable Location
-Added Corpse Pit Area
-Added Blanchmyre Discoverable Location
-Added Blanchmyre Area
-Added Wind Chimes Randomized Sound Effect
-Fine Tuned the Soundtrack List to Feel more "Gloomy"
-Diseased State is now MUCH Worse than Before (You should REALLY avoid getting diseased if you don't have medicine to cure it, it reduces all attributes but 20% now instead of just 10%)
-Diseased State no longer goes away on its own
-Capitalized EXP on the HUD so it's universally the same

notes.title: 1/17/20 Update 1.4.2 [Combat Overhaul/Polish/Roleplay Update]
notes.content:
[b]Lawless Lands[/b],

Hey everyone!

This update is another one of those gigantic types. Working torches, more roleplay features, combat overhaul, tons and tons of polish that brings the game much closer to a finalized state, some fixes, ease of play solutions, player comfort changes, and a whole hell of a lot more content and features!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32931945/0ac9c3de1d2b36bbe38250e7a6facecf1daa0639.png[/img]

One of my favorite changes with this update is the torch system. Torches are now no longer useless misc items that serve no purpose. Have a dark dungeon to delve into? Bring some torches to light your way! Another big change is to the combat system. A ton of new specific skills have been added along with animations to make it much more diverse and strategic. Not only you can get the new skills and abilities, though... Enemies can too! Campfires can now be used to cook raw meat from hunted animals and you can even take torches from them as well! Welcome, traveler, to the [i]Lawless Lands[/i].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32931945/4ff4bb2d61eca0e5c20111a0d142f031a833e007.gif[/img]

Check out the complete change log below!

[b]Update 1.4.2 Change Log:[/b]

Bug Fixes:

notes.title: 1/7/20 Update 1.4.1 (Alignment System/C&C Update)
notes.content:
[b]Lawless Lands[/b],

Hey everyone!

Here is the next huge update for the game! Our most important new feature is the addition of the alignment system which brings choice and consequence!

Taken from the previous dev status post:
"The alignment system is now a real thing. Though not originally planned, I found that the game felt like it was missing something - freedom of choice and consequences and rewards based on player made choices. Now, you have full control over your presence in the game world. Choose to be an evil villain? Sure. A benevolent hero? Sure. Somewhere in between? Sure. Just a jerk? Yep! 

There are two scales which control your alignment which are good vs evil and law vs chaos. In the game, they are your disposition and soul. Disposition is your standpoint on justice or lawlessness. The color of your soul is your point of view on good vs evil. A bright soul is good, a black soul is evil and a dim soul is in the middle. There are a variety of ways you can change these as they will constantly update depending on your choices. EVERY SINGLE QUEST that is relevant to these has been updated with more choices and alternate outcomes. That's like 70 quests right there. Yes, I updated them all. "That's a lot of work." - Yeah, you're telling me. Then, on top of that, all of the random world map events that have something to do with good vs evil or law vs chaos have been updated as well. There is also a pop up text system to show when your alignment changes.

Think of a scale where 0 - 100 is considered neutral and 101 - infinity is good/justice and everything below 0 is evil/chaos. This is how the alignment system is gauged. Small and minor choices may influence the scale by 1-5 points. The larger the situation and choice, the bigger the alignment shift."

Check out the complete change log below!

notes.title: 1/6/20 Development Status Update
notes.content:
[b]Lawless Lands[/b],

Hey everyone!

I had a second to spare, so I decided to stop by here and talk about the next update which will be coming in a few days if all goes well.

The alignment system is now a real thing. Though not originally planned, I found that the game felt like it was missing something - freedom of choice and consequences and rewards based on player made choices. Now, you have full control over your presence in the game world. Choose to be an evil villain? Sure. A benevolent hero? Sure. Somewhere in between? Sure. Just a jerk? Yep! 

There are two scales which control your alignment which are good vs evil and law vs chaos. In the game, they are your disposition and soul. Disposition is your standpoint on justice or lawlessness. The color of your soul is your point of view on good vs evil. A bright soul is good, a black soul is evil and a dim soul is in the middle. There are a variety of ways you can change these as they will constantly update depending on your choices. EVERY SINGLE QUEST that is relevant to these has been updated with more choices and alternate outcomes. That's like 70 quests right there. Yes, I updated them all. "That's a lot of work." - Yeah, you're telling me. Then, on top of that, all of the random world map events that have something to do with good vs evil or law vs chaos have been updated as well. There is also a pop up text system to show when your alignment changes.

Think of a scale where 0 - 100 is considered neutral and 101 - infinity is good/justice and everything below 0 is evil/chaos. This is how the alignment system is gauged. Small and minor choices may influence the scale by 1-5 points. The larger the situation and choice, the bigger the alignment shift.

As for other upcoming features, another village has been added and this one is unique as it is the first "dead" village. The Plague really did a number on it, so now the village is left to rot. Who knows what horrors (or treasures) you may uncover there?

There are a lot of other quality of life improvements to make the game easier to play and to be more pleasant of an experience. A block sound effect was added for when an attack is blocked and no damage is dealt! Huzzah!

The intro to the game has been updated to have a bit more interactive items/entities as well. It felt a bit too empty. It is intended to ease the player into the game, but chances are, they want to see how it works and plays as quickly as possible, so more has been added.

One new magic item that will be helpful as a utility is the Chrono Stone. Basically, it's a magical pocket watch. Ever wondered what the actual time was in game? Wonder no more! With a Chrono Stone, you can now know the exact in game time.

There are also many more changes with the next update, but you'll have to wait and see them for yourself when the update comes out!

Enjoy!

notes.title: Upcoming Content Additions
notes.content:
[b]Lawless Lands[/b],

Hey everyone!

Over the past month, I've been very busy with college work but I wanted to stop by real quick and post about some new content features coming to Lawless Lands.

[b]Fast Travel[/b]:

Yes, fast travel will be added into the game. Originally, I didn't want to add this feature as I thought it would make the game too "impersonal" and thought it would take away from the experience. The in game world map events are randomized and I added them to make traveling more interesting, but I feel that the game map has become so large that some form of fast travel is needed. While I don't know yet exactly how I am going to implement this, know that several ideas are being discussed and brainstormed and it will definitely be in the game soon.

[b]Base Building[/b]:

As many of you know, the recent update added the first real upgradable/buildable objects in the game - destroyed bridges that could be repaired to allow faster movement to the surrounding area and also awards some fame for your charitable work. Like with my previous games Waste Walkers and Disgraced, Lawless Lands is going to have a form of base building and management as that has always been a favorite for the majority of the community. It will work similarly to how it did in Disgraced as you'll be able to purchase upgrades and hire servants and other workers to perform specific duties around the area. More details on this will be released soon.

[b]Main Storyline[/b]:

The main plot of the game is still being worked on and has a lot more in store for everyone to enjoy. The focus of my development lately has been finishing the game world (world map) by filling it out with places to explore, side quests, flavor, settlements, and so on. Now that I'm almost finished with that, I plan to focus on the story and make it much larger and have a lot of depth like originally planned.

That's all I have time for at the moment, I have to go take a final exam now. Over the next few weeks, I plan to devote a lot of time to the game's development and hopefully have a lot of progress to show for it in the coming months.

Thank you for reading!

-[b]Corrosion[/b] ːCStudiosː

notes.title: 10/25/19 Halloween Update 1.3.6
notes.content:
[b]Lawless Lands[/b],

Hey everyone!

Here's the big Halloween update with tons of spooky things to do and lots more content as well! Several new side quests, many new enemies, a couple of new settlements, and a lot more have been added in this update so don't miss out!

On a personal side note, while I was working on this update, two of my beloved pets passed away within a few days of each other and I chose to honor and incorporate them into the game as companions so they can live on eternally and so their memory is forever remembered. They each have their own unique personality and trait and are free to acquire if you manage to find them. I later added my other pets who I've lost as well. [b]Corrosive Supporters[/b],

Well, today Corrosive Studios turns 5 years old. I can't wrap my mind around that. notes.title: 8/24/19 Developer Status Update
notes.content:
[b]Lawless Lands[/b],

Hey everyone!

I just wanted to stop by real quick and let you all know how the game's progress has been coming. I haven't done an update or post in about 2 weeks but that's because I was working on finals for school. I have however, continued working on Lawless Lands and have been making some great progress for the next update!

As always, polish, lots of new content, new features, and more are coming with the next major patch, but it won't be out for a little while. 

[b]A Coming Change to Dying in Combat[/b]

[u]Something I wanted to mention[/u] was a change to combat concerning the "Orbs" in game that allow you to revive allies when they die. Some players have come to me and explained how difficult the game is when playing without companions in the company. The game is meant to be difficult and not really hold your hand, but I think I found a good middle ground for this. Basically, when the player doesn't have any companions and it's only the player character, if they die in combat, Orbs in the inventory will automatically be used to revive the player's character. THIS ONLY APPLIES TO THE PLAYER CHARACTER WHEN THEY ARE ADVENTURING ALONE. To explain how the system works, a conditional will check how large the current company size is when combat initiates. If it is anything greater than 1, nothing will happen. If it is at 1, the player will be temporarily set to immortal - unable to be killed. Then, it will check if the player has any Orbs or Lesser Orbs in their inventory. If they do, the player will continue to be temporarily immortal. If not, immortality will turn off. Now, when the player character dies, Orbs will take priority over Lesser Orbs, so the player will be revived for 20% of their Vigor. If they have no regular Orbs (stronger), the game will take Lesser Orbs (weaker) and the player character will be revived with 10% of their Vigor. This will make it so the player has a chance to win a battle, even if they die once or twice. Orbs are RARE and hard to come by, and Lesser Orbs are very costly so I think this is a good change to make everyone happy. I may change the Orbs and Lesser Orbs to heal a base amount + the percentages too.



The good news is that I'm taking a short break from my schooling for the next term (8 weeks) and then getting back to it. During that time, I'm going to be focusing on the game's development and have a lot of time to make some really big steps toward's finishing the game up. It's be something like 7-8 semesters that I've been going non stop, so I thought this would be a good self-health care idea and also give me time to work on my project which I'm VERY excited about.

My break from school/devoted time for Lawless Lands technically started a day ago when I finished my current classes and term but I am taking the weekend off for myself and to spend some time with my family. I'll begin working again on the game starting Monday, Aug 26.

I'll keep you all posted!
